title: Furious
creator: 試作にゃん/sisaku-nyan
style_raw: Immediate DRY FEMALE DOUBLE-TIME RAP on beat one, no intro; hip-hop first, never sung verses. D minor, 184 BPM double-time over a heavy 92-BPM live boom-bap backbeat, 4/4, ~3:10. (I) Punchy live kick/snare, melodic deep bass, clipped grand-piano chords; gaps for sharp consonants, no trap or synths. (II) Domenico Scarlatti Sonata K.141 in D minor: recast its furious repeated piano notes as short two-bar sixteenth-note ostinati in straight 4/4; no 3/8 meter shifts or keyboard solos. (III) Verses dry, low-mid, percussive RAP; Pre uses rapid P/T/K/S attacks, then one beat of silence. (IV) ONLY choruses sing: breathtaking original soprano minor-key melody, gradual ascent to sustained A5 on HOLD, long connected legato, expressive suspensions and delayed resolution. Repeat the identical eight-bar chorus hook; final chorus adds cello counterpoint. D minor to the end. Four-bar piano-bass hard stop. No humming, spoken skits, major-key escape, or modulation.
